verses.text: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. To the tune of Alamoth. God is our safe place and our strength. He is always there to help in times of trouble.
So we will not be afraid, even if the earth shakes and the mountains fall into the middle of the sea,
even if its waters roar and foam and the mountains shake as the waters rise. Selah.
There is a river whose streams make the city of God glad, the holy place where the Most High lives.
God is in the middle of that city. It will not fall. God will help it at the break of day.
The nations are in an uproar. Kingdoms fall. God raises his voice, and the earth melts.
The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
Come and see what the LORD has done, the ruins he has brought on the earth.
He stops wars all over the world. He breaks the bow and snaps the spear. He burns the chariots with fire.
He says, "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be honoured among the nations. I will be honoured in the earth."
The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
